PingGateway (IG, :3036)
DEFAULT MCP gateway
Selected by ff_mcp_gateway_pinggateway (default true)
Warms Authorize on startup (best-effort)
Authorize outage: AUTHORIZE_FAILOVER_MODE=deny (fail-closed 503, default)
fallback_simulated (mock authz-server :9001) is opt-in only
Sends UserId + McpResourceUri in Authorize params
RFC 8693 single-resource exchange
